contract: build_model() -> torch.nn.Module mapping (batch, 40) float inputs to (batch, 10) logits, with at most MAX_PARAMETERS parameters. The evaluator trains it with Adam (lr 1e-3, batch 128, STEPS steps) on the deterministic MNIST-1D training set and reports test_error + 0.05 * parameters / 100000. Lower is better.
notes: EvoPrompting's MNIST-1D setting recreated on the CPU: the mnist1d package regenerates the dataset deterministically; the training budget and the size penalty are local choices (the paper reports test error and parameter count).
protocol_description: Reimplemented in this repository from the paper's task description; instances are generated locally with a fixed seed, so scores are comparable within the suite but not with the paper's numbers.
